en: Illustrated postcard showing two German soldiers in blue uniforms with pickelhaube helmets shaking hands in the foreground, one holding an Imperial German flag. Behind them are inset black‑and‑white photographs: one of a building with towers and another panoramic view of a riverside cityscape with church spires. Decorative foliage frames the images. The greeting text on the right reads "Gruss aus Lübeck." A small red number "No 1225." is printed at the bottom.
